title: plugin-grid: the bulk action confirm sentence still formats its numbers and dates in en-US for every viewer, because BulkActionDialog does not pass the display locale to fillTemplateHoles
body:
Filing gate ②: the remainder of card #26232 that its fix, PR #26282, left to another PR, which merged without it. ⛔ Not a claim.

**What is left.** #26232 had two symptoms in action copy templates. (1) A root named `locale` hijacked the formatter locale. (2) With no such root, formatters rendered in `en-US` instead of the viewer's language. PR #26282 closes (1) in the engine for every caller: `EvalContext.locale` is now the only locale channel. It closes (2) for an action's `confirmText` and `successMessage`, because the console's runners install `useDisplayLocale()` through `ActionRunner.setDisplayLocale`. It left (2) open on the bulk confirm dialog. PR #26217 was rewriting `bulkConfirmText.ts` and `BulkActionDialog.tsx`, so #26282 named #26217 as the carrier. #26217 merged at 2026-10-26 19:54Z without that change.

**Business reason.** A bulk confirm sentence such as "Set the amount to {{ amount | currency }} on {{ count }} records" formats its numbers and dates in `en-US` for a Chinese or German viewer, while the same action's single-record confirm formats them in the viewer's language.

**Where.** On `main`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/bulkConfirmText.ts` `bulkConfirmText()` calls `fillTemplateHoles(source, bulkConfirmTemplateScope(scope))` with no locale. After #26282, `fillTemplateHoles` (`ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionCopyTemplate.ts`) takes the locale as its third parameter. The likely shape is one argument: `BulkActionDialog.tsx` reads `useDisplayLocale()` and passes it through `bulkConfirmText` to `fillTemplateHoles`, with a pin that a formatted hole renders in a non-English display locale. ⛔ No second locale resolution.

**Blocked by** #26282, which adds `fillTemplateHoles`'s locale parameter and is under review.

**Found by.** The #26232 os-dev report (comment 6425204871) and the contract review on PR #26282 (comment 6426083828), boundary flag.

**Duplicate check.** Searched this repo, open and closed, for "bulk confirm locale", "BulkActionDialog useDisplayLocale" and "fillTemplateHoles locale". The only hits are #26232 and its PRs; none of them is this remainder.
